_comment: Large world-map binaries used to be tracked in Git LFS, whose free bandwidth (1 GB/mo, shared org-wide) was exhausted by a handful of installs. They now live as assets on a GitHub Release, whose download bandwidth is free and unmetered. scripts/fetch-map-assets.mjs reads this manifest and downloads any listed file that is missing or out of date; the launcher and updater call it instead of touching Git LFS. When a map file changes: upload the new asset to the release below and update its sha256 + bytes here. The two big pmtiles are the z8 trims (scripts/trim-pmtiles.mjs): the map mounts both sources at maxzoom 8 and never asks for z9 or z10. The website fetches its own list (scripts/map-assets.web.json). A packaged beta shares the stable app's copy of these files, so change them on every branch in the same release, or the two apps re-download each other's map on every launch. The last entry is the stock GADM world that every scenario without a map of its own renders on; the built-in Modern Day scenario's OWN map is not listed here at all — it ships inside the app under server/seed/default/ and the server seeds it into the data directory (see docs/assets-and-data.md).
